subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
Yellow scientific buoy at 44 40.755N 063 36.720W temporarily removed, red floats connected by line remain with small buoy in the middle until further notice.
Mariners are requested to avoid these areas to prevent additional damage and hazards.
                                                    Cancels NW-M-1430-26
